Kaf. Ngifunga ngeKurani ehloniphekile.
Empeleni bamangazwe ukuthi kufike kubo umexwayisi ongomunye wabo, bathi laba abangakholwa: “Lesi isimanga sento”.
Ingabe uma sesifile saba inhlabathi [siyophinde sibuyele esimeni]; lokho ukubuya okusekudeni.
Impela sikwaze kahle lokho umhlaba okucuyayo kubo; futhi sineNcwadi elondloziwe.
Empeleni baphike iqiniso selifike kubo; baphithene.
Abasiboni yini isibhakabhaka ngaphezu kwabo ukuthi sisakhe kanjani sasihlobisa futhi asinambobo.
Nomhlaba siwundlalile safaka kuwo izikhonkwane [izintaba] futhi sakhiqiza kuwo yonke inhlobo enhle yesitshalo.
Ukuze kube imvulamehlo nesikhumbuzo kuleso naleso sigqila esizithobayo.
Futhi sehlise amanzi emvula abusisekile, sakhulisa ngawo izivande nezinhlamvu ezivunwayo.
Nezihlahla zamasundu ezinde ezinezithelo eziyizixhobo.
Ukuze kube yisondlo kuzigqila. Saphinde savuselela ngawo [amanzi] indawo efile. Futhi nokuvuswa [kwabafileyo] kuyobanjalo.
Ngaphambi kwabo, isizwe sika Nuhu nabantu base Rasi [umthombo] nabakwa Tamudi zaphika.
Kanjalo nabakwa Adi noFirawuni nabafowabo baka Luti.
Nabantu bezivande [eMadiyana] nesizwe sika Tuba’. Bonke abazikholwanga iZithunywa, bafanelwa isijeziso.
Ingabe sehluleka yini ukudala okokuqala na?; empeleni bona banongabazana mayela nokudalwa kabusha [ukuvukeni kwabafileyo].
Sadala umuntu futhi siyakwazi lokho izinkanuko zakhe ezimhlebela kona; phela siseduze kuye ukudlula umthambo wakhe.
Lapho abaqophi ababili beqopha behleli ngakwesokunene nangakwesonxele.
Noma iyiphi inkulumo ayishoyo kunengqapheli enaye kuyo yonke indawo.
Bafika ubunzima bokufa ngeqiniso. Yilokho obuzama ukukubalekela.
Kuyoshaywa uphondo, lolo kuyobe kuwusuku oluthenjisiwe.
Wonke umuntu uzoza ehamba nomelusi nofakazi.
Ubukade ungakulindele lokhu [usasemhlabeni]; isithiyo sakho sisisusile, ngakhoke namhlanje ukubona kwakho kubukhali.
Ingqapheli yakhe [eqophayo] iyothi: “lokhu okukimi kumi ngomumu”.
[Kuyothiwa kuzingelosi ezimbili]: “Jikijelani eJahanamu lowo nalowo ongakholwa onekhanda eliqinile”.
Ovimbela okuhle umndlwembe ongabazayo.
Lona obhangqe u Allah nesinye isikhonzwa. Mjikijeleni esijezisweni esinzima.
Umngani wakhe [ongumdukisi] uyothi: “Nkosi yethu, akumina engimdukisile kepha nguyena vele obesekudukeni okujulile”.
Uyothi [u Allah]: “Ningalokhu niphikisana la phambi kwaMi, kade nganithumela isexwayiso phambilini”.
Isinqumo asiguquki kiMi futhi angisoze ngenza okungebulungiswa kusigqila.
Ngosuku lapho siyothi kwi Jahanamu: “Ingabe usugcwele na?”. Iyothi: “Bakhona abaseza na?”.
Futhi iJana iyosondezwa eduze kwalabo abathobela u Allah.
Lokhu yikona okuthenjiswe kulowo nalowo ozilahlayo noqaphelayo [imiyalelo ka Allah].
Lowo osaba Onomusa engamboni futhi oyofika nenhliziyo ezisolayo.
[Uyothi]: “Ngenani kuyo ngokuthula”. Lolo usuku lwaphakade.
Bayothola abakuthandayo kuyo futhi sinokunye okungaphezulu.
Ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa ngaphambi kwabo ezazinamandla ukudlula bona, balizulazula izwe; ingabe ukhona owaphunyuka na?
Impela kulokho kunesikhumbuzo kulowo onenhliziyo eqondayo nolalelisayo futhi onakayo.
Futhi sadala amazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwakho ezinsukwini eziyisithupha futhi asizange sikhathale.
Ngakhoke kubekezelele lokho abakushoyo; ubabaze udumo lweNkosi yakho ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga nangaphambi kokuba lishone.
Nasebusuku, idumise nasemuva kokukhothama [ukwenza iswala].
Futhi lalela ngosuku lapho ummemezi eyomemeza endaweni eseduzane.
Ngosuku lapho beyozwa umsindo [wophondo] ngeqiniso. Lolo usuku lokhuphuma [emathuneni].
Impela Thina siletha ukuphila siphinde sikuthathe futhi isiphetho sikithi.
Ngosuku lapho umhlaba uyoqhekeka ubavulekele baphume beshesha; lokho ukubuthanisa okulula kithi.
Thina sikwazi kahle abakushoyo, futhi wena awuphoqi muntu kubo; ngakhoke khumbuza ngeKurani lowo osaba isexwayiso saMi.
